s3.k1: Grassroots players, builders, and tone chasers
s3.k2: Venom Guitars was built for musicians — and we mean that. From garage jammers to gigging pros, this community is for anyone who cares about playing great instruments built right here in Australia.

s4.k4: We started as players. We know what it's like to deal with a guitar that fights you. Everything we build is designed around the player experience — playability, tone, and feel over everything else.
s4.k6: Want to learn lutherie? We actively encourage it. Share your builds, ask questions, and get real feedback from people who've made the same mistakes and figured out how to fix them.
s4.k8: The Australian music scene is world-class and chronically underrepresented. We want to amplify local artists, support local gigs, and shine a light on the incredible talent in this country.

s5.k5: Full build series, playthroughs, setup tutorials, and behind-the-scenes workshop footage.
s5.k8: Build progress photos, finished guitars, resin pours, and Reel content from the shop floor.
s5.k11: Quick tips, satisfying machining clips, resin art pours, and guitar content that actually performs.
s5.k14: Community discussion, announcements, event info, and for those who still use Facebook (we love you).
